description: This file contains selector functions for managing and retrieving thread-related data in a Mattermost web application, including thread IDs, thread details, last viewed times, and reply filtering with separators.

methods.name: getSelectedThreadIdInTeam
methods.description: Retrieves the selected thread ID in the team from the global state.

methods.name: getSelectedThreadIdInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Selector that retrieves the selected thread ID for the current team.

methods.name: getSelectedThreadInCurrentTeam
methods.description: Selector that retrieves the current user's selected thread object in the current team.

methods.name: makeGetThreadLastViewedAt
methods.description: Creates a memoized selector to get the last viewed timestamp for a specific thread.

methods.name: isThreadOpen
methods.description: Determines if a thread is currently open based on state and thread ID.

methods.name: isThreadManuallyUnread
methods.description: Checks if a thread is marked as manually unread.

methods.name: getThreadLastUpdateAt
methods.description: Retrieves the last update timestamp for a thread.

methods.name: makeFilterRepliesAndAddSeparators
methods.description: Creates a selector that filters posts, adds date and new message separators for thread view.

methods.name: makePrepareReplyIdsForThreadViewer
methods.description: Prepares reply IDs for thread viewer by filtering and combining user activity posts.

methods.name: getThreadToastStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the toast status for threads from the state.
